description: Sanitized PDI troubleshooting patterns for xml.

patterns.name: Store Closed but Poll XML Was Not Generated
patterns.summary: Store Close can complete while the expected poll XML/reports fail to generate.

values: did not generate the poll files
poll files and reports were not created

match_rules.label: Store Close batch failure is reported

patterns.next_safe_step: Confirm Store Close completed and that the expected poll XML is absent. If confirmed, use the approved Repoll XML Files recovery rather than repeating Store Close.
patterns.why: Historical cases repeatedly distinguish a successful Store Close from a failure to generate usable poll XML afterward.
guardrails: Do not tell the store to repeat Store Close merely because XML is missing.
Verify regenerated files before Poll Day.

patterns.name: Poll XML Present but Bad / Malformed
patterns.summary: Poll files may exist yet still be unusable because the generated XML is incomplete or malformed.

values: Files present but timestamps look wrong

match_rules.label: Poll XML exists but is suspected bad

patterns.next_safe_step: Inspect the existing poll XML/timestamps for evidence that the files are invalid before regenerating them.
patterns.why: Files being present does not prove they are valid; historical cases include generated poll files that could not be used until XML was regenerated.
recommended_evidence: Begin/end values or malformed data evidence
guardrails: Do not delete or replace files based only on file count.
Regenerate XML only after confirming the existing files are unusable.
